result.headline: Not a priority right now
result.basis_label: From figures you entered; not checked against bills

used.text: A full year of figures you entered (June 2025 to May 2026) shows $3,141 a year in energy costs. We haven't checked them against your bills.
Energy use is 14.2 kBtu per square foot a year. A typical place of worship uses 30.5, so this building uses 0.47 times as much (no more than typical).
Electricity costs $0.179 per kWh, well above the Indiana average of $0.1244 for businesses.

summary.means: At this level of spending, an energy project is unlikely to pay for itself. That doesn't mean nothing can be saved; it means other sites are a better use of time right now.
summary.next: No action needed. If your costs change or you have a project in mind, run the audit again.
summary.note: kBtu (a thousand British thermal units) is a standard unit that lets electricity and gas be added together.

result.honesty_line: This is a quick first look to help decide where to spend time. It is not an energy assessment, and it does not estimate savings.
